name: Scrubby
summary: Email validation with instant single checks, queued bulk batches and slower deep verification.

api_key.description: a Scrubby API key (your Scrubby account settings)

notes: Every call is a POST with a JSON body. Credits are used per email submitted.
Rate limit: 25 requests per second per API key.

Bulk flow: submit the list to scrubby.bulk.submit, wait retry_after_seconds, then poll scrubby.bulk.results with the identifier every 30 to 60 seconds until status is completed. Deep flow works the same with scrubby.deep.submit and scrubby.deep.results, but takes up to 72 hours.

endpoints.name: Validate one email
endpoints.summary: Result, status and quick status for one address, returned immediately.
notes: A read over POST: it only checks an address.
Server timeout is 100 seconds; a 408 still costs the credit, and resending the same request within 24 hours is free and returns the same verification.

endpoints.name: Submit a batch for validation
endpoints.summary: Queues a list of emails and returns an identifier and retry_after_seconds.

email.description: List of email addresses to validate.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces data and uses credits. Fetch the outcome with scrubby.bulk.results.

endpoints.name: Fetch a batch's results
endpoints.summary: Status (processing or completed) and per-email results for a quick batch.

identifier.description: The identifier returned by the submit call.

notes: A read over POST. While status is processing, emails show result 'pending'; poll every 30 to 60 seconds.

endpoints.name: Submit a batch for deep verification
endpoints.summary: A slower, more thorough batch check; returns an identifier and a retry_after_seconds of up to 86400.

email.description: List of email addresses to validate.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces data. Fetch the outcome with scrubby.deep.results.

endpoints.name: Fetch deep verification results
endpoints.summary: Status and results in three windows: results_24, results_48 and results_72.

identifier.description: The identifier returned by the submit call.

notes: A read over POST. Stop polling when status is completed; all three windows are then final.
